mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, enabled FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT r.code FROM roles r JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permissions p JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT p.code FROM permissions p JOIN user_permission up ON up.permission_code=p.code WHERE up.user_id=#{userId} AND up.status='APPROVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(username, display_name, password_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash})
INSERT INTO user_roles(user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM roles WHERE code = #{role}
